name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Account Manager | Reviews & Reputation, APIs, Integrations
summary: Technical account and partner manager with 15+ years in SaaS, including direct experience in the review and reputation space at Birdeye and Fivestars. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 reseller partner book at Birdeye by guiding technical setup, catching adoption gaps early, and feeding structured issues to Product and Engineering. As a solo founder, builds review-generation and automation systems hands-on, connecting platforms through REST APIs, Zapier, Make, and n8n and writing JavaScript and Python in custom code steps. Explains the same issue to a developer and a business owner, and owns problems through to resolution.
